svg.title: How many people have been given each drug in a study
svg.desc: Bar chart of people given the active drug in studies. Tesamorelin, FDA-approved in 2010 for HIV belly fat: 740 patients in its approval trials. Ipamorelin by vein: 86 in published studies, 30 healthy men in 1999 and 56 surgery patients in 2014, plus a 320-patient trial that finished in 2014 and was never reported. Ipamorelin under the skin, the way it is sold: 0 published. CJC-1295 with DAC: 63 healthy adults, mostly one shot, plus a 192-patient trial stopped in 2006 after a death. CJC-1295 without DAC, the version in most X stacks: 0. CJC-1295 and ipamorelin together: 0.
